purpose: Review fix F1-F4 changed ve/ and lean/ after the seven-corpus A/B (head 074f96d3); the corpora that reach the readings routes are recorded again on the fixed code and compared with the saved base recording.
commands: uv run python tools/lean_first_diff.py record --root . --out head.jsonl --corpus readings norm_defaults document --workers 4
uv run python tools/lean_first_diff.py compare base2.jsonl head.jsonl --corpus readings norm_defaults document --json compare.json
